highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the renderer to Skia m153 and incorporates native lifetime and GPU correctness fixes.
highlights_body: Linux font fallback can choose a different face. HarfBuzzSharp uses a new package revision bucket, not a new native engine version.

breaking.title: Linux fallback font selection may change
breaking.body: Fontconfig now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Use an explicit family/style or a bundled typeface when deterministic font selection matters.

bullets.detail: Advances the bundled renderer without managed API or native C ABI changes. HarfBuzzSharp package revision .300 still uses native HarfBuzz 14.2.1.

bullets.lead: Glyph-atlas and GPU failure handling corrected
bullets.detail: Prevents stale atlas reuse after partial glyph updates, propagates failed native flushes, and rejects incomplete GPU-buffer uploads under memory pressure. Managed flush signatures remain unchanged.

bullets.lead: Cached-data cleanup releases the mutex before deletion
bullets.detail: Avoids unlocking a mutex through freed storage when SkCachedData is released.

bullets.lead: Windows HarfBuzz binaries pass BinSkim BA2007
bullets.detail: Consumers no longer need to baseline the disabled-critical-warnings error in libHarfBuzzSharp.dll. The native exports and shaping behavior are unchanged; other existing BinSkim warnings are unaffected.

preview_summaries.v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6: Preview 1 introduced Skia m153, its Linux fallback-font selection change, and the cached-data mutex lifetime correction.
preview_summaries.v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2: The release candidate prepared the m153 line for stable release without additional collected product changes.

harfbuzz_summary: The Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 by scoping vendored-source warning suppression. The bundled HarfBuzz engine and exported ABI are unchanged.

v4.153.0-preview.1.26454.6.headline: Preview 1 introduced Skia m153, its Linux fallback-font selection change, and the cached-data mutex lifetime correction.

v4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2.headline: The release candidate prepared the m153 line for stable release without additional collected product changes.

v4.153.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.153.0 finalizes glyph-atlas and GPU-buffer failure corrections.
v4.153.0.body: It also corrects the Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim BA2007 disabled-warnings error.
